topics.topic: Capture of failed execution into TrialCase after a failed run has been released (spool removed)
questions: After a failed run is released (spool removed), can its failed function execution still be captured into TrialCase, especially when inputs included files?
After a failed run is released (spool removed), is capture from its node executions still allowed, and under what condition?

topics.topic: Activation idempotency when activating an already active flow version
questions: If the requested version is already the active version, does activation append a new FlowActivation record or return existing active state without change?

topics.topic: Agent-triggered activation behavior for non-read-only flow versions in State 1
questions: When an agent calls activate on a proven non-read-only flow version, what concrete product action result exists in State 1: refusal, deferred owner task, or immediate owner-side activation path?

topics.topic: FlowVersion deduplication semantics and authorship fields for identical content
questions: If an agent composes flow content identical to an existing FlowVersion, is the existing version reused, and if so which authored_by/authored_at are kept?

topics.topic: Re-grant semantics after revocation (new StandingGrant ID vs reactivation)
questions: If the owner grants again for the same node/version after revocation, is that a new StandingGrant entity (new grant_id) or reactivation of the revoked one?

topics.topic: Resolve-unknown action behavior when EffectAttempt is not currently unknown
questions: What happens if resolve is called when the EffectAttempt is not currently `unknown` (already resolved, not yet unknown, or wrong attempt)?

topics.topic: Revoke action behavior when no active StandingGrant exists
questions: What must `revoke` do when no active grant exists for that flow-version node (already revoked or never granted)?

topics.topic: StandingGrant lifecycle when its flow version becomes inactive (dormant vs auto-revoked)
questions: Does an active grant remain active while its flow version is inactive and become effective again if that version is reactivated, or is it auto-revoked on deactivation?

topics.topic: When installation changes take effect (runtime reload vs restart required)
questions: Do non-token installation changes (especially manifest revision, service instances, credentials) take effect only after restart, or are they reloaded at runtime?

topics.topic: Whether EffectApproval can still be decided after run/node is no longer waiting, and required response
questions: Can the owner still decide a `requested` EffectApproval after the run has ended or the waiting point is gone, and if not, what response is required?

topics.topic: Whether accepting an OperationBinding proposal is allowed after manifest drift
questions: If the manifest record changed after proposal but before owner acceptance, is accepting that stale proposal allowed or refused?

topics.topic: Whether refused start creates Run/NodeExecution records or no run trace at all
questions: When start is refused, is any Run (M19) or NodeExecution trace record created, or is the call refused with no run record?

topics.topic: Whether standing grants are allowed for read/draft-write nodes that do not require per-run approval
questions: Can a standing grant be created for `read` or `draft-write` operation nodes that never require per-run approval?
